Methods

OnScroll(KeyBindingScrollEvent<T>)

Triggered when a scroll action is pressed.

bool OnScroll(KeyBindingScrollEvent<T> e)

Parameters

e KeyBindingScrollEvent<T>

The event containing information about the scroll.

Returns

bool

True if this Drawable handled the event. If false, then the event is propagated up the scene graph to the next eligible Drawable.

Remarks

When the action is not handled by any osu.Framework.Input.Bindings.IScrollBindingHandler`1, osu.Framework.Input.Bindings.IKeyBindingHandler`1.OnPressed(osu.Framework.Input.Events.KeyBindingPressEvent{`0}) is called. In either cases, osu.Framework.Input.Bindings.IKeyBindingHandler`1.OnReleased(osu.Framework.Input.Events.KeyBindingReleaseEvent{`0}) will be called once.
